column3: NASB follows the critical text; it renders “implore” as “request” and “abound” as “excel,” adds “instruction,” and puts “just as you actually do walk” in parentheses.
NASB renders “instructions” as “commandments” and “through the Lord Jesus” as “by the authority of the Lord Jesus.”
NASB renders “to control his own vessel” as “to possess his own vessel” and “holiness” as “sanctification”; the meaning of “vessel” is uncertain.
NASB renders “the passion of lust” as “lustful passion.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “go beyond and overreach” as “transgress and defraud” and “thoroughly warned” as “solemnly warned.”
NASB renders “to impurity” as “for the purpose of impurity” and “into holiness” as “in sanctification.”
NASB follows the critical text (“gives,” “to you”); it adds “this.”
NASB renders “brotherly love” as “the love of the brethren” and adds “anyone.”
NASB renders “exhort” as “urge” and “abound more and more” as “excel still more.”
NASB follows the critical text without “own”; “strive earnestly” is rendered “make it your ambition.”
NASB renders “walk” as “behave” and “have need of no one” as “not be in any need.”
NASB follows the critical text (“we do not want,” “those who are asleep”); “ignorant” is rendered “uninformed.”
NASB renders “through Jesus” as “in Jesus” and reorders the verse.
NASB renders “loud command” as “shout” and reorders the verse.
NASB renders “caught away” as “caught up” and “for the meeting of the Lord” as “to meet the Lord.”
